checks.independentPeer: Independent reviewer Codex takedown_routing read all ten full EN/RU bodies, the complete Python fixture, checker and heading helper, all five reports and source decisions. The missing transitive heading-helper dependency was identified and fixed, then read back. Final checker passed all ten candidates, 71 retained anchors and 118 equal math spans; all five sets of eight current file hashes matched. A fresh Python 3.9.7 process reproduced saved JSON byte for byte. A separate oracle independently constructed the 32 directed events and 14 nonzero counts, evaluated expected SGNS by enumerating each positive event and all six noise outcomes, and recomputed the GloVe objective with its 1/(2M) normalization. Complex-step derivatives checked all 24 SGNS and 36 GloVe gradient coordinates at initial, final and additional points (maximum gap 1.1e-16). The peer also independently checked the duplicate-negative one-step loss/update, isolated-score optimum, exact Fraction n-gram smoothing/interpolation, count-vector cosines/projection, all subword sums/means/hash IDs, separate classifier softmax and all 16 collision-gradient coordinates. Standard replay covered the saved 1200/800-step trajectories; no second independently implemented optimizer trajectory is claimed. All ten manifest code/license blobs were freshly fetched and SHA-matched. Selected exact functions, headers, Apache/MIT license grants and cached nontruncated license-tree summaries were read. Primary-source comparison covered Mikolov 1301 sections3.1–3.2 and1310 sections2.2–2.3, GloVe section3 equations7–9, TACL subwords sections3.1–3.2/6.3 and Joulin section2. The disclosed unconditioned-noise/full-batch choice, GloVe normalization, custom ASCII hash and API-mean distinction agree. No borrowed distinctive table/code/data/result was identified in this new scope. This is a recorded-use comparison, not a repository-wide rights guarantee.
